issue.title: Retarget inbound [[podcasts#^z-...]] links to per-show notes
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-f.1 (epic bob-cli-f, Modernize the quote.md and podcasts.md vault notes).

Evidence (re-verified 2026-08-06 by the bob-cli-f land agent against the live ~/bob vault):
- 'grep -rho "\[\[podcasts#\^" --include=*.md ~/bob' => 36 occurrences across 21 files.
- All 36 still resolve: every anchor target exists exactly once in the rewritten podcasts.md (the epic deliberately carried all 17 legacy ^z- anchors onto the new hub lines).

Scope: rewrite each inbound '[[podcasts#^z-YYMMDD-xx|alias]]' reference to point at the corresponding '[[podcasts/<slug>|alias]]' per-show note created by bob-cli-f.1, preserving each link's existing alias text and surrounding prose. The anchor -> slug mapping is the ## Subscribed / ## Unsubscribed lists in ~/bob/podcasts.md and the 'source_anchors' frontmatter key on each podcasts/<slug>.md note. Leave quote.md's four [[podcasts#^z-241027-07|twit]] references and the rest consistent with whatever decision is made (they are part of the 36).

Impact: cosmetic/readability only - nothing is broken today. The epic plan explicitly deferred this (see 'Alternatives considered and rejected': 36 edits across ~20 unrelated notes for cosmetic gain, much larger blast radius).

Caution: writes go to the LIVE vault at ~/bob/ (not the sase clone); do not commit there - 'bob bulk-git-commit' owns vault commits.
